newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Morris up on tobacco win.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Morris up on tobacco win.

text.p: Shares of Philip Morris Cos Inc rose five to 93 in U.S. pre-open trading after four tobacco companies won a key tobacco liability case in Indiana late Friday, traders said.

The jury ruled in favor of Philip Morris, RJR Nabisco Holding Corp's R.J. Reynolds Tobacco Co, Brooke Group Ltd's Liggett Group Inc and the American Tobacco Co, now owned by Brown & Williamson, a unit of B.A.T Industries Plc.
The tobacco industry's legal win comes amid plans for greater federal regulation of the product.
Traders said RJR Nabisco was trading at 27, up from Friday's 25-3/8 close.
In other news, MFS Communications Co Inc shares rose to 49 ahead of the U.S. stock market opening from Friday's 34-7/8 close after it and WorldCom Inc agreed to merge in a stock swap, traders said.
In another deal, Spreckels Industries Inc rose 4-5/8 in the pre-open from Friday's 19-3/8 close after news Columbus McKinnon Corp definitively agreed to buy it.
Columbus McKinnon will begin a tender on or before August 30 for all outstanding shares of Spreckels at $24 a share.
